with open(GRAPH_TTL) as f: ttl=f.read()
import re
def block(name):
    i=ttl.find(name)
    # find end of a block: next line "\n." then blank
    j=ttl.find("\n .", i)
    return ttl[i:j]
# zone F4_Z05 and F4_Z02 rooms
for z in ["bldg:Zone_F4_Z05","bldg:Zone_F4_Z02"]:
    b=block(z)
    print("====",z); print(b)
    print()

def tsfor(room):
    m=re.search(re.escape(room)+r"\.Occupancy_Sensor.*?ref:hasExternalReference <urn:buildgraph:tsref:([0-9a-f-]+)>", ttl, re.S)
    # ensure point is occupancy (match room.Occupancy_Sensor then capture tsref within that statement)
    # better: find block starting at room.Occupancy_Sensor
    idx=ttl.find(room+".Occupancy_Sensor")
    end=ttl.find("\n .", idx)
    blk=ttl[idx:end]
    mm=re.search(r"hasExternalReference <urn:buildgraph:tsref:([0-9a-f-]+)>", blk)
    return mm.group(1) if mm else None
